name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for waiver of the immunity of Petr Bystron
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided to lift the legal protection (immunity) of Petr Bystron, a German member of the European Parliament. German prosecutors in Munich want to charge him with corruption, money laundering, fraud and tax evasion. They say he took cash and cryptocurrency payments from the operator of a pro-Russian website in return for speaking and voting in Russia's interests. Lifting his immunity allows the German authorities to pursue these criminal proceedings against him.

- **What changes:** Bystron loses his immunity, so German prosecutors can proceed with criminal charges against him.
- **Who it affects:** Petr Bystron, a member of the European Parliament elected in Germany in 2024.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's President sends the decision to the German authorities and to Bystron.
